_comment: Quote of the day shown on the student dashboard's banner — a new one each calendar day, same for every student that day. Owner-editable: add/remove/edit entries freely. How to edit: see data/README.md.

quotes.text: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: We've all got both light and dark inside us. What matters is the part we choose to act on.
quotes.speaker: Sirius Black

quotes.text: It is our choices, Harry, that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good.
quotes.speaker: Harry Potter

quotes.text: Fear of a name increases fear of the thing itself.
quotes.speaker: Hermione Granger

quotes.text: Working hard is important, but there is something that matters even more: believing in yourself.
quotes.speaker: Harry Potter

quotes.text: You sort of start thinking anything's possible if you've got enough nerve.
quotes.speaker: Ginny Weasley

quotes.text: Books! And cleverness! There are more important things — friendship and bravery.
quotes.speaker: Hermione Granger

quotes.text: It matters not what someone is born, but what they grow to be.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: Age is foolish and forgetful when it underestimates youth.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: The best of us must sometimes eat our words.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore

quotes.text: Being different isn't a bad thing.
quotes.speaker: Luna Lovegood

quotes.text: Understanding is the first step to acceptance, and only with acceptance can there be recovery.
quotes.speaker: Albus Dumbledore
